List of Wikimedia chapters | Wikimedia chapters are national or sub-national not-for-profit organisations created to promote the interests of Wikimedia projects locally. They organise regional conferences, outreach and global events such as Wikimania.  As of January 2015 there were 41 recognised Wikimedia chapters.
